description: Look up a recorded screen by object, context and framework. Returns its running screen URL, content hash, brand and theme. No new screen is generated. object_registry reads the definition behind the screen. Set reproduce true when the command and calls used to generate it are requested.

context.description: The context the screen was composed for.

framework.description: The framework of the generated app.

object.description: An object with recorded screens at this version.

reproduce.description: Include the command and calls for reproducing this result.
